conbody.p: Emergency Stop is a function designed to assist an unresponsive driver. If this system determines that the driver is unresponsive, the system can maintains the vehicle in the center of the road and assists in stopping through deceleration control.

section.title: Detecting sensor
section.p: The front camera and front radar are used as detection sensors to recognize vehicles ahead. Please refer to for the applicable sensors and their locations.
